family_change_recorded_here_before_any_p.the_old_family: ONE THING FOUND OUT BY THE HAND GOING INTO A SPACE NOBODY CAN SEE INTO, AND NOTHING CHANGED. RUN SEVEN BLOCKS, 0073 TO 0079.
family_change_recorded_here_before_any_p.the_family_may_be_changed_and_the_author: THE 0080 PROMPT SAYS SO IN TERMS AND `AGENTS.md` WINS, AND THIS IS THE CHANGE.
family_change_recorded_here_before_any_p.what_the_old_family_could_not_do: IT COULD NOT CARRY A DECISION OR A CONSEQUENCE, BECAUSE EVERY CHAPTER ENDED WITH NOTHING CHANGED, AND `AGENTS.md` ASKS EVERY CHAPTER FOR SIX THINGS OF WHICH A DECISION AND A CONSEQUENCE ARE TWO. A HUNDRED AND THIRTY GESTURES WENT INTO IT AND NOT ONE PERSON IN SEVEN BLOCKS WAS GIVEN A PRONOUN, A WANT OR A CHOICE. THE PERSON WHO ANSWERED THE VISITOR WAS `the other` AND `the one` AND WAS NEVER ON STAGE AS A PERSON.
family_change_recorded_here_before_any_p.what_the_new_family_can_do: IT CAN CARRY THE SIX, BECAUSE A WANT IS THE BEGINNING UNDER PRESSURE, THE ASK IS THE GOAL A READER CAN STATE, THE REFUSAL OR THE ASK IS THE RESISTANCE, THE DECISION IS THE CHANGE, THE COST OF IT IS THE COMPLETED BEAT, AND WHAT THE OTHER PERSON DOES WITH IT AFTER HE HAS GONE IS THE ENDING THAT OPENS SOMETHING.
family_change_recorded_here_before_any_p.rules_that_go_with_the_old_family_and_go: NOTHING MARKED CUT FASTENED FILLED SHIMMED OR PUT RIGHT; NO SECOND HANDS FROM THE VISITOR; THE VISITOR NEVER SEES THE THING IN HAND; THE VISITOR NEVER REFUSES AND NEVER PASSES THE WORK ON; NOTHING DISCOVERED THAT NOBODY CAN SEE INTO. ALL OF THOSE WERE CONSEQUENCES OF THE OLD FAMILY AND ARE GONE WITH IT.
family_change_recorded_here_before_any_p.what_is_kept_from_the_old_regime_and_why: THE MATERIAL TEXTURE IS KEPT AND IT IS THE BEST THING IN THE BOOK. LONG CONCRETE SENTENCES ABOUT CAST AND BEDDED AND LAID AND THE WEATHER GETTING AT THEM. THE MEASURED WORLD. THE FIVE STANDING PLACES. THE VISITOR TIES. THE GATES. WHAT IS GONE IS THE FROZEN HAND.

the_protagonist.what_he_wants_and_it_is_one_thing_for_te: HE WANTS TO BE ON THE BOOK AT THE LOCK-UP. NOT TO BE BUSY. TO BE ENTERED AGAINST WORK, WITH A NAME AGAINST HIS, THE WAY THE MEN HE HAS WORKED BESIDE ARE. HE HAS NEVER ASKED FOR IT. THE BLOCK IS WHAT HAPPENS WHEN HE STARTS ASKING.
the_protagonist.what_it_is_about_and_it_is_the_volumes_o: A PERSON WHO IS NOT ENTERED IS NOT A PERSON WHO IS HELPED, AND BEING ENTERED IS NOT THE SAME AS BEING ASKED. HE LEARNS THE SECOND HALF OF THAT SENTENCE THE HARD WAY AND SPENDS THE LAST FOUR CHAPTERS ACTING ON IT.

HE IS NOT CLEVER AND HE IS NOT RIGHT ABOUT PEOPLE. HE IS RIGHT ABOUT WALLS.

cards.985: At the unit, inside the store, at the bench under the roof light with the wide door standing open behind him, the woman from two doors down wants the dishing flag step outside number two made safe before the rain comes back. She has three weeks and no money for it. He wants to be asked for work he can put down in a book, and asks her who else she would have gone to, and she names a man he has worked beside who has a name in the book and he has not. He asks to be paid, is refused, does it for nothing, and tells her out loud that he is not on the book.
cards.986: At number twelve, in the back kitchen with the range out and the yard window over the sink, the woman of seventy-eight has been asked to sign that she is content to be left, and cannot read the paper without her glasses and has signed. Her sister comes in from the yard and wants him to tell her the old woman is all right. He explains what the clause in fact does, and the sister takes it as him keeping her mother at home, and the old woman asks him a question that nobody has asked her in a year. He offers to put what she says in ink, and she gives him one sentence, and it is not the sentence he had in mind.
cards.987: At number nine, in the front room with the chimney breast he came to look at, the firebrick back has come away at one corner and there is a space behind the breast a hand could go into. HE DOES NOT PUT A HAND IN IT. HE LOOKS AT IT WITH A SMALL MIRROR ON A LATH AND READS THE WIDTH OFF THE REFLECTION AND THE DEPTH OFF THE SIDE. The woman in her late fifties, alone, wants on the list she has heard about. He asks her whether she wants to go. She does not answer that. She asks him for a pencil and paper and puts her own name down on it, because being entered means being helped and being helped means not having to ask anybody for anything again.
cards.988: At number ten, in the front room, he is to take down a partition of breeze block between the front room and the back one. The woman in her early thirties with a sister has been offered a place on the crew going up the river and cannot decide, and wants him to decide it. He refuses to decide it for her, which is the decision of the chapter, and is told that not being asked is the whole of what is wrong with him. He does the day's work and it moves nothing, and she is angrier at the end than at the beginning.
cards.989: At the lock-up, inside the office with the book open on the desk and the window over the bay behind her, the woman who books work lays out the clause: two men, six weeks, up the river, and every part of it correct. He wants to be on the book and is told the book is not hers, the book is the men's. He asks to be one of the two and she will not be the one who asks him, because she will not ask in a room with nobody else in it. He presses and is given the reason: the last crew she asked came back and were not entered again. He asks who is on it now and she names two, and one of them is the woman who does her shopping.
cards.990: At number nine, in the back room with the paper off the walls and the old picture hooks still in the plaster, the woman who does her shopping tells him before he asks that she is on the list and put her name down without him. He admits he made the asking wrong at nine: he asked her a question and then treated the answer as final when the question was not his to ask. He says he will ask her properly. She says not yet. Ask me when you have something of your own at stake, because a man with nothing to lose will ask anybody anything. His reading of her for two chapters is wrong and she lets him find it out.
cards.991: At number ten, in the back kitchen with the bottom rail of the back door split and the wind coming through the gap. He can put a strip of wood in it in a minute and the woman will not have it and he does not do it. She has decided to take a place and wants him to put her forward; he has decided to ask people; there are two places and one of them is at nine and one of them is here. He asks the woman in her early thirties to go and does not ask the woman at nine, and knows what that costs. He finds the second place is already spoken for, and it is the woman from two doors down, who never told him.
cards.992: At the lock-up, inside the middle bay with the shutter down and the echo in it, the woman who books work comes through to him and the price is put on the table: if the crew goes the work stops for the season and a book with no work on it is a book that closes. He asks her for a third column on the book — a line for the man they come back to — and there is no third column, because there has never been a third column. That is the chapter. He asks her to read the two names out and she does and he does not say a word, and she does not ask him to.
cards.993: At the unit, in the office with the sash down and a length of floorboard on two trestles he has been meaning to plane, the woman from two doors down comes and he has to stand by what he told her. He gives her the whole of it, including that he has asked one person and not the other and that he wants a place himself and cannot have it. She asks him why he asked her at all, and he tells her she is on the list, and she did not know, and she has not put anything down. She tells him the work stops with the crew and there is nothing to enter him for and the book closes at the end of the season whatever he does. That is the cost and it is on the page and it is not about his feelings.
cards.994: At number twelve, in the front room with the fire out and the sister packing and not packing, the old woman asks him to put a second line in ink telling her daughter she is not to come, and he agrees, and the cost of agreeing is that he has asked her to choose and nobody has ever asked her to choose. She chooses to go. Then she takes the sheet he made her in 986, reads it, and strikes out one word, because he has set down that she has no objection, and she will not carry that, because nobody has ever asked her, and she has an objection, and it is not the one he chose.

declared_ordinary_word.sense: LEVEL AND STRAIGHT IN RELATION TO THE THING IT IS SET AGAINST, AND OF NOTHING ELSE. ONE SENSE ONLY. FOR WALLS, SLABS, SASHES, BOARDS, BLOCKWORK, FIREBRICK, SHUTTERS AND PAPER AND FOR NO OTHER SENSE.
declared_ordinary_word.why_this_word: THE RUN SO FAR IS ROUGH, SLICK, BLUNT, BRITTLE, STIFF, COLD AND DAMP, AND TRUE IS NOT ANY OF THEM. IT IS THE FIRST WORD THAT IS A RELATION BETWEEN A THING AND WHAT IT IS SET AGAINST, WHICH IS EXACTLY WHAT THIS BLOCK IS ABOUT: A MAN ASKING FOR WHAT HE IS AGAINST, AND BEING WRONG ABOUT A WOMAN BECAUSE HE MEASURED HER AGAINST HIMSELF INSTEAD OF AGAINST WHAT SHE HAD.
